about_the_game:
Welcome to the Servant of the Lake demo, a short preview of what’s to be expected of you as a servant to the infamous Vanderboom family! Visitors are arriving soon, and you are meant to start your housekeeping duties immediately! 

There's a long weekend ahead, but for now, solve the puzzles needed to fulfil your first assignments, which include helping Mr. Aldous prepare to welcome the coming visitors!

Servant of the Lake is the new upcoming premium point-and-click adventure in the Rusty Lake series from the creators of the Cube Escape series, The Past Within and Underground Blossom. With this free-to-play demo, we hope to give you a taste of what's to come! 

The Servant of the Lake Demo has an expected gameplay time of 15-30 minutes.

Features:

  • A first look at Servant of the Lake– Enjoy a preview of our upcoming premium game, Servant of the Lake. A classic Rusty Lake point-and-click adventure is set in the infamous Vanderboom house during the era of Aldous and William Vanderboom.

  • Solve surreal puzzles – Step off the carriage and into your first tasks as one of the servants of the Vanderbooms. Explore some of the rooms of the estate, meet your help and employer, and solve puzzles in anticipation of the coming guests!

  • Immersive soundtrack - Haunting melodies composed and performed by Victor Butzelaar to keep you company while puzzling your way through your daily, usual and unusual tasks.

Let us know what you think by leaving a review, and please remember to Wishlist Servant of the Lake to be the first to find our the release date while staying in the loop with all development news!

short_description: Begin your new job as a servant at the mysterious Vanderboom estate. Solve puzzles, serve the family and uncover their dark alchemical secrets in Servant of the Lake, a new upcoming single-player point-and-click adventure in the Rusty Lake series.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese
